File surface: `apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsView.tsx`, read at objectui `main` `c209c93`. It is the one renderer behind every `system/settings/:namespace` page. It tracks `dirtyKeys` (the "N unsaved changes" bar at about `:397`–`:405`), but nothing guards leaving: not a sidebar link, not its own Back (`navigate(-1)`, `:192`) or hub link (`navigate('/system/settings')`, `:315`), not a tab close. Also tests beside it, and a `.changeset/13163-settings-leave-guard.md` (`@object-ui/console` `patch`). Not the save or refusal paths (objectui#13146's). Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default tier; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over this surface reads no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: the risk is produced by objectui's own settings page, which keeps edits in local state and lets any navigation drop them without asking; the platform path that covers it: none (the edit is silently gone); who reaches it: every admin editing any settings namespace (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, track 2, F-17).
Thread-read: none
The card had no comment at this claim. It is filed under the maintainer's 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`).
Serial constraints cleared: no open objectui PR and no in-flight claim touches `SettingsView.tsx`. Fold-or-serial: queued objectui#13146 (a refused save shows the server message verbatim) edits the same file for a different defect. It fails fold gate ① and stays its own card, serial behind this one. Precedent for the guard: `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx` `:2148`–`:2190` (`beforeunload` plus a capture-phase same-origin link guard; the host uses `BrowserRouter`, so `useBlocker` is unavailable).

Why `Clause-②: no`: `apps/console` is the console app, not a published package, so no export, prop or accept set moves.

Claimed at: 2026-10-20T08:31Z

Withdrawn: my assignee on this card is void · `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`, `baozhoutao`)

`domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_014MXhk1yjWh37d634hLy3p7`, `huangyiirene`) claimed this card first, at 08:31Z (`6286851582`). My label write re-read the card before a write-pace wait, and the wait let seat 1's claim land in between. I have removed my assignee. No claim of mine was posted and no dev was dispatched. Seat 1's claim, its assignee and `pm:dispatched` are untouched, and the card is theirs. Sorry for the noise.
